display_revisit.resolution: The full original became visible; all copy, paper hands, tool contacts and local material edges were inspected.
display_revisit.reason: First original-detail display was limited to a corner fragment.

text.comparison: All twelve raw entries equal under nfc-ws-optical-v1; exact observed line wraps retained separately.

style.checked_requirement: Distributed top-down material repair network, precise matte-paper forms and wood/textile detail; compact sans title and mature low-contrast serif body
style.observation: Hands are now paper silhouettes; wood/textile/tools connect across the field. Large central heading and some side-view chair/tool volume remain as concrete limitations.

ratio.observation: Native image is within predeclared nearest-integer edge rounding; no rescaling of original.

substantive_visual.observation: Large chair rail joint/clamp at left and cloth tear/patch/needle at right show actual shared repair, linked by screwdriver, spool, thread and scissors. These are substantive action shapes, not small ornaments.

hangul.observation: Uniform serif anatomy, visible counters, regular baseline and clear word spaces; title uses a different heavier sans role.

information_relationship.observation: Title/declaration lead to one central-left description, then two adjacent event/application openings connected by wood and cloth edges. Both lower groups are wider/larger than repair-1.

function_contact.observation: repair.example/join is contiguous and upright; no QR/logo requested or added.

material_edge_finish.observation: Paper-hand silhouettes are clean; wood grain and textile fibers retain coherent scale. Torn margins and some tool/wood depth remain.

excluded_template.observation: Large wood/clamp and fabric/stitching shapes with hands occupy the field and actively define the reading openings; imagery is substantive and connected rather than small additions on a passive field. Central type remains heavy.

format.observation: One flat landscape poster, visibly opaque, no mockup or panels; native PNG color type recorded from header.

located_observations.observation: Paper hand turns red clamp handle, another supports the wooden rail; clamp contact visibly presses the joint.
Paper hand holds needle aimed at frayed fabric beside patch; lower hand stabilizes thread/fabric. Burgundy stitching visibly bridges patch edge.
Event/date/time/place and cost/deadline/item/URL are separate nearby groups of comparable body weight.
Wood diagonals, upper shared tools and right textile mass frame a large central read; heading remains the first typographic anchor.

residuals.observation: Title and declaration remain large; assigned compact junction heading was not fully achieved.
Flat paper hands and material connections improve the assigned genre, but chair/clamp retain some side-view volume and the graph largely surrounds one central reading opening.
Paper boundaries retain rough torn-edge texture rather than uniformly precise clean cut edges.
All groups are readable at the inspected 720 width, but their body remains below the prompt's approximate 16–17px design intention; smaller displays are not assured.
Original-detail display showed only a corner; one high-detail revisit of the identical original displayed the complete file.
Visible text and long dash were read optically; Unicode encoding and actual font-file application cannot be certified from raster.

decision: Select repair-2 as the most suitable own inspected outcome: closest paper action forms, all copy retained, and greater event/application readability than repair-1. No further native calls remain.
